scp.scpmod.scp_173.desc: A statue made of concrete and rebar. It cannot move while directly observed; unwatched, it closes in at extreme speed and snaps the target's neck.
scp.scpmod.scp_500.desc: A small tin of red pills that cures almost any disease or debuff. Repeated use builds up tiered resistance.
scp.scpmod.scp_005.desc: An ornate brass key that opens any lock. It can also activate complete End Portals and light complete Nether Portal frames.
message.scpmod.scp005.end_portal_incompl: The End Portal frame is incomplete, or is missing Eyes of Ender.
message.scpmod.scp005.end_portal_already: The End Portal is already activated.
message.scpmod.scp005.nether_portal_alre: The Nether Portal is already open.
screen.scpmod.motto: Humanity can no longer live in fear. Nothing can protect us - we must protect ourselves. We Secure. We Contain. We Protect. - The Administrator
message.scpmod.scp005.gateway_too_far: You are too far from the End Gateway (must be within 4 blocks).
message.scpmod.scp005.gateway_cooling: The End Gateway is still cooling down.
message.scpmod.scp005.gateway_entered: The End Gateway teleports you away.
screen.scpmod.motto.full:
Humanity has existed for 250,000 years, but only the last 4,000 of them have been meaningful. We Secure. We Contain. We Protect.

Mission Statement: Operating in the shadows around the world, the Foundation's goal is to contain anomalous objects, entities and phenomena. We maintain normalcy so that the rest of humanity can live in an ordinary, rational world.
